info.title: SIMS — Savemore Investigation Management System API
info.description: REST API for SIMS. Authenticate with `POST /auth/login` (session cookie). Every state-changing request must send the header `x-sims-csrf: 1`. Responses use `{ data, meta?, requestId }`; errors use `{ error: { code, message, details }, requestId }`. Automated statement analysis results are investigative leads that require human verification, not proof.
